DistantPartner.title: When He's Distant/Cold
scripts: I notice you've been quieter lately, and I miss our connection. Is everything okay on your end?
I feel the distance growing, and I want us to bridge it together. Can we talk?
I've been feeling a bit disconnected from you lately. I'd love to hear about your day when you have a moment.
I value our communication so much, and it feels a bit off right now. I'm here when you're ready to share.
I'm missing our usual rhythm. Let's find a time to catch up properly soon.
I want to make sure I'm supporting you well. You seem a bit distant—is there anything you'd like to talk about?
I cherish our bond, and I'm feeling a bit lonely in it today. Sending you love.
I'm noticing a shift in our energy. I'm choosing to stay open and wait for us to find our flow again.
I miss the warmth of our conversations. I'm looking forward to our next deep dive.
I'm here, holding space for us. Whenever you're ready to lean back in, I'm ready to receive you.

PostArgument.title: After an Argument
scripts: I've had some time to reflect on our talk. I'm sorry for my part in the tension and I want to move forward with love.
I value our relationship more than being right. Can we try to see each other's perspective again?
I'm still feeling a bit tender after our disagreement, but I want you to know I still love you deeply.
I'd like to revisit our conversation when we're both feeling calmer. I want to understand you better.
I'm choosing to let go of the frustration because our peace is more important to me.
I'm sorry things got heated. I want to learn how we can handle these moments with more grace together.
I'm here and I'm committed to us. Let's talk about how we can heal this together.
I miss being on the same team. Can we find our way back to that today?
I've been thinking about what you said. I want to find a middle ground that respects both our needs.
I love you, and I'm ready to put this behind us. Let's focus on our connection now.

FeelingUnheard.title: Feeling Unheard
scripts: I've been feeling like my needs aren't quite landing lately. I'd love for us to have a heart-to-heart soon.
It's important to me that I feel understood by you. Can we talk about how I've been feeling?
I'm struggling to feel heard in our recent conversations. I value your perspective and want to share mine too.
I feel a bit invisible when I share my day. I'd love it if we could focus more on each other's experiences.
I'm sharing this because I care about us: I'm feeling a bit disconnected and unheard right now.
I want to feel like a priority in your life. Can we discuss how we can make more space for my feelings?
I'm feeling a bit lonely in my thoughts. I'd love to feel your support and understanding today.
I value our honesty. Right now, I'm feeling like my voice isn't quite reaching you.
I'm looking for a bit more validation in our talks. It helps me feel safe and connected to you.
I want us to be each other's safe haven. I'm feeling like I need a bit more of your listening ear right now.

SettingBoundaries.title: Setting Boundaries
scripts: I value our time together, but I need some space for myself tonight to recharge. I'll check in tomorrow.
I'm not comfortable with how we're communicating right now. Let's take a break and talk when we're both ready.
I need to prioritize my well-being right now. I won't be able to talk until later this evening.
I love our connection, but I need to set a limit on our late-night calls so I can rest properly.
I'm feeling overwhelmed. I need us to slow down our communication for a bit so I can process things.
I'm choosing to step away from this conversation for now. I want us to speak with respect and love.
I need to be clear about my needs: I require more consistent check-ins to feel secure in our LDR.
I'm setting a boundary for myself: I won't engage in talks that feel disrespectful or dismissive.
I value my peace. I'm taking some time offline today and will be back when I feel more centered.
I'm learning to honor my limits. Right now, I need some quiet time to myself.

MissingEachOther.title: Missing Each Other
scripts: The distance feels heavy today, but my love for you is even heavier. I'm counting down the days.
I'm missing your presence so much. Sending you a virtual hug until I can give you a real one.
I'm thinking of our last visit and it's keeping me going. I miss you more than words can say.
Even though we're apart, you're always in my heart. I'm so grateful for our connection.
I'm feeling the gap between us today. I'm looking forward to our next call to feel close again.
I miss the simple things—like just sitting in silence with you. Can't wait for that again.
The miles are many, but our love is stronger. I'm missing you deeply today.
I'm holding onto our memories until we can make new ones. I miss you, my love.
I'm so proud of us for navigating this distance. I miss you and I'm so lucky to have you.
I'm sending you all my love across the miles. I can't wait to be in your arms again.
